selected_evidence.requirement: Disable acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) for IPv4 persistently
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed accept_redirects=1/secure_redirects=1; new /etc/sysctl.d config set both to 0 for all interfaces, applied live, and confirmed 0 both immediately and after reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Disable acceptance of source-routed packets (accept_source_route) for IPv4 persistently
selected_evidence.summary: accept_source_route explicitly pinned to 0 in persistent config for all/default/lo/enp1s0 and confirmed 0 before and after reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart evidence protocol: boot identity change, service/config recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 739c9792... before reboot, issued shutdown -r now, polled until node1 responded with new boot_id 0ae6621f... and uptime 0 min, then verified the hardening sysctl settings and config file survived the restart
